install_output_empty: Palibe zotulutsa pano. Mizere yomaliza kuchokera pachida choyikira idzawonekera apa.
linux_setup_title: Linux Flashing & SP Flash Tool Setup
linux_setup_welcome: Kukhazikitsa SP Flash Tool ya Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Kutsitsa ndikusintha injini yowunikira kwambiri kuti muthe kubwezeretsa ndikusintha wosewera wanu mosavuta.
linux_card_engine_desc: Chida chowunikira cha MediaTek chokhala ndi laibulale yapadziko lonse lapansi yopangidwa.
linux_card_usb_desc: Amapereka chilolezo cha desktop kuti alankhule ndi wosewera mpira mu Bootloader mode.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Tool System Checker & Diagnostics
system_checker_desc: Kutsimikizira kwathunthu kwa madalaivala, ma module a kernel, zilolezo, ndi malaibulale othamanga kuti muwonetsetse kuwunikira kodalirika.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Imakonzekeretsa kompyuta yanu kuti ilumikizane ndi wosewera wanu kuti musinthe mapulogalamu.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Imayang'ana kukhazikitsidwa kwa Linux kwa SP Flash Tool, mwayi wa USB, zilolezo za serial, ndi zida zamakina.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Imakonzekeretsa kompyuta yanu kuti ilumikizane ndi wosewera wanu ndikukhazikitsa zosintha zamapulogalamu modalirika.
settings_checker_desc: Imakonzekeretsa kompyuta yanu kuti ilumikizane ndi wosewera wanu ndikukhazikitsa zosintha zamapulogalamu modalirika.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Kompyuta yanu yakonzeka kulumikiza wosewera wanu.
linux_prep_not_connected_friendly: Mutha kulumikiza wosewera mpira wanu atafunsidwa.
linux_prep_blocked: Kompyutayi siyitha kugwiritsa ntchito SP Flash Tool.
linux_prep_fix_body: Mawu anu achinsinsi amafunikira kamodzi kuti muyike kompyuta iyi kuti iwunikire: malamulo a USB pazida za MediaTek ndi mwayi wofikira padoko.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Kuti mukhazikitse kompyutayi ya SP Flash Tool, mawu anu achinsinsi adzafunika mu sitepe yotsatira kuti mukonze malamulo a USB ndikuwonjezera akaunti yanu kumagulu ogwiritsira ntchito omwe amafunikira. Mukakana, pulogalamuyo itsekedwa.
linux_prep_fixed: Kufikira kwaloledwa, SP Flash Tool yakonzeka.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Kukhazikitsa kwatha ndipo akaunti yanu yawonjezedwa kumagulu ogwiritsira ntchito SP Flash Tool. Chonde yambitsaninso kompyuta yanu kuti zilolezo zatsopano ziyambe kugwira ntchito, kenako mutsegulenso pulogalamuyi. Dinani cholembera kuti mutseke pulogalamuyi tsopano.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Zachitika, Tsekani App kuti Muyambitsenso Kompyuta
settings_driver_desc: Musanagwiritse ntchito pulogalamuyi kwa nthawi yoyamba, muyenera kukhazikitsa dalaivala wa MediaTek USB, ndikuyambitsanso kompyuta yanu.
home_desc: Pezani fimuweya pa intaneti kapena sankhani phukusi lakwanu, ndikuwunikira ku chipangizo chanu.
sel_source_desc: Tsitsani firmware pa intaneti, kapena lowetsani phukusi lapafupi.
settings_advanced_desc: Imawonetsa njira yoyika, mawonekedwe oyika ndi zosefera.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install_desc: Pulogalamuyi imakhala ndi inu pakuzimitsa, kulumikiza, ndi kukhazikitsa.
settings_sp_gui_install: Ikani mu SP Flash Tool GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Imatseka Updater ndikutsegula SP Flash Tool GUI ndi fayilo yosankhidwa ya firmware yobalalitsa ndi zithunzi zogawikana zolowetsedwa.
settings_terminal_desc: Imayendetsa kukhazikitsa mapulogalamu anu mu Terminal kuti muwone zambiri zaukadaulo pazomwe zikuyenda.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Imayendetsa kuyika kwa pulogalamu yanu mu Command Prompt kuti muwone zambiri zaukadaulo pazomwe zikuyenda.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Zosankha. Zolinga zina za MediaTek zimakana kuwunikira mpaka SP Flash Tool itapatsidwa fayilo yotsimikizika (.auth); onjezani yanu apa ngati chipangizocho chikufunika.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Palibe fayilo yomwaza yomwe idapezeka mu phukusili, kotero palibe lamulo la console lomwe lingamangidwe.
terminal_install_no_tool: Palibe SP Flash Tool build kapena MTKClient polowera yomwe ilipo panjira iyi.
terminal_install_failed: Sitinathe kutsegula zenera la terminal. Lamulo lokhazikitsa linalembedwa kuti {path}.
status_terminal_install: Ikani lamulo lotsegulidwa pawindo lanu la terminal ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} tsopano itsegula kuthamanga {method}.

• Ngati sichinazimitsidwe, zimitsani {device} yanu.
• Ngati chikugwirizana ndi USB, chotsani kaye.
{hint}
• Lumikizani chipangizo chanu ku kompyuta yanu pamene zenera la {terminal_name} latsegulidwa.

Dinani Chabwino kuti mutsegule ndikutuluka Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Langizo: Ngati chipangizocho sichikulumikiza zokha, dinani pang'onopang'ono batani lokhazikitsiranso pabowo la pinwo ndi paperclip mukulumikiza chingwe cha USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Langizo: Ikani chipangizo chanu mumodi yotsitsa ya fimuweya (zimasiyana motengera mtundu: mwachitsanzo chotsani batire ndi kuyisunga kuti ikhale yolumikizidwa ndi chingwe cha USB, kapena thimitsani ndi batire, kapena gwiritsitsani Volume Pansi/Mmwamba mukulumikiza USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Ikani kudzera pa SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI tsopano itsegula ndi firmware yanu yodzaza.

• Mu SP Flash Tool, sankhani "Koperani" kuchokera m'bokosi lotsitsa.
• Dinani "Koperani" batani.
• Onetsetsani kuti {device} yanu yazimitsidwa ndi kulumikizidwa.
{hint}
• polumikiza USB chingwe kuti kompyuta pambuyo kuwonekera Download.

Dinani Chabwino kuti mutsegule SP Flash Tool ndikutuluka mu Updater.
settings_install_themes_desc: Ikayatsidwa, mitu ya Rockbox imasamutsidwa yokha ku Y1 ndi Y2 mutakhazikitsa bwino Rockbox.
themes_placement_failed_note: Sitinathe kuyika paketi yamutu pa wosewera wanu. Mutha kuyesanso kuchokera ku Zikhazikiko.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Onetsani Mapulogalamu Oyambirira amatulutsidwa akale kuposa 3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Mapulogalamu Oyambirira Otulutsidwa akale kuposa 3.0.7 sagwirizana ndi mayunitsi a Y1 ogulitsidwa ndi Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Kuwunikira nyumba yakale pamayunitsi awa kudzawalepheretsa kuyambiranso mpaka mtundu watsopano utabwezeretsedwa.

Kodi mukutsimikiza kuti mukufuna kuwonetsa zotulutsa Zoyambirira Zapulogalamu zakale kuposa 3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Imawonetsa zomanga zomwe zip ya ROM ili yosiyana ndi 240p (rom…_240p.zip). Zomanga za 240p sizigwirizana ndi mayunitsi a Y1 pa Innioasis OS pansi pa 3.0.7, kotero Show Old Rockbox Builds imayatsidwa nayo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Zotulutsidwa za Rockbox-Y1 isanakwane 0.5 sizigwirizana ndi mayunitsi a Y1 omwe adagulitsidwa pambuyo pa Marichi 2026 yokhala ndi Innioasis OS 3.0.7 yoyikiratu.

Kuyatsa nyumba yakale pazida izi kuletsa kuyambika.

Kodi mukutsimikiza kuti mukufuna kuwonetsa zomanga zakale za Rockbox?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Chonde sankhani .zip, .rar archive, kapena scatter file (*scatter*.txt) mkati mwa foda ya firmware kuti muyike firmware yomwe mwasankha pa {target} yanu.
sel_offline: Zolemba pa intaneti sizikupezeka pakali pano. Gwiritsani ntchito fayilo yapafupi, kapena onani kulumikizana kwanu.
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Maphukusi angapo a firmware kapena mafayilo omwaza adapezeka mufoda/nkhokwe iyi. Chonde sankhani chikwatu kapena zosungidwa zomwe zili ndi pulogalamu ya firmware imodzi yokha nthawi imodzi.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Kutulutsidwa kumeneku kuli ndi mafayilo omwaza opitilira umodzi, kotero Updater sangathe kudziwa mtundu womwe wosewera wanu akufuna. Wopanga {software} angafunike kusintha zotulutsa zawo za firmware kuti ziphatikize fayilo imodzi yomwaza.
sp_search_restart: Palibe chipangizo pano, kusakanso (kuyesera {count}). Sungani wosewerayo azimitsidwa ndikulumikiza mukafunsidwa.
sp_auth_missing_file: Fayilo yotsimikizira sinapezeke ({path}); kuwala popanda izo.
sp_config_missing_platform: Fayilo yobalalitsa sichilengeza nsanja yake, kotero kasinthidwe ka konsoni ka fayilo yotsimikizika sikungamangidwe; kuwala popanda izo.
sp_config_missing_storage: Fayilo yobalalitsa sichilengeza mtundu wosungirako (EMMC/NAND/UFS), kotero kasinthidwe ka konsoni ka fayilo yotsimikizika sikungamangidwe; kuwala popanda izo.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Palibe fayilo yotsimikizira yomwe idaperekedwa; kuthwanima popanda mmodzi.
sp_config_write_failed: Sitinathe kulemba fayilo yosinthira; kuwunikira popanda fayilo yotsimikizika.
settings_notifications_desc: Onetsani zidziwitso zamakina zachidziwitso ndi mitundu yosinthira pansipa. Kuzimitsa kumasunga zonse mkati mwa pulogalamuyi.
settings_add_device_type_hint: Mtundu ndi wosewera wa hardware kukonzanso. Osewera amtundu womwewo amatha kumangidwanso mopitilira kamodzi - mwachitsanzo Mtundu A ndi Mtundu B - ndipo mapulogalamu amapangidwira m'modzi mwa iwo. Chongani chomata kumbuyo kwa wosewera mpira; ngati sichitchula mtundu, siyani chosankha choyamba.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Palibe zomasulira zomwe zilipo papulogalamuyi pakali pano.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Sungani pulogalamuyo mu bar ya menyu zenera likatsekedwa, kuti mulandirebe zidziwitso zosintha za pulogalamu ndi wosewera mpira. Kutseka: kutseka zenera kusiya pulogalamuyi.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Sungani pulogalamuyo mu trayi yamakina zenera litatseka, kuti mulandirebe zidziwitso zosintha za pulogalamu ndi wosewera mpira. Kutseka: kutseka zenera kusiya pulogalamuyi.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Bisani kalozera wa anthu pa intaneti ndikuyika mapulogalamu kuchokera kumafayilo am'deralo okha.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Mwawunikira kapangidwe ka 360p Rockbox. Kodi mungafune kukhazikitsa 360p Theme Pack pa chipangizochi tsopano?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Lumikizani Player mu USB Storage Mode
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Chonde chotsani USB, yatsani ndikuyatsa mu Rockbox kamodzi (kotero imayamba foda yake yamkati ya .rockbox), kenako gwirizanitsani USB ndikusankha 'USB Storage Mode'.

Mukalumikizidwa, dinani Pitirizani kusankha chikwatu chilichonse pa wosewera wanu.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Sankhani chikwatu chilichonse pa chosungira wanu cholumikizidwa player
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack idayikidwa bwino pazida zanu!
sel_dialog_filter: Mafayilo a Firmware (*.zip *.rar *mwaza*.txt *.txt);;Zosungidwa (*.zip *.rar); Mafayilo Omwaza (*mwaza*.txt *.txt);;Mafayilo Onse (*.*)
sel_only_local: Sankhani .zip kapena .rar firmware phukusi, kapena chikwatu / scatter .txt wapamwamba, kukhazikitsa popanda intaneti, palibe intaneti yofunika. Imagwira ndi chosewerera chilichonse cha Innioasis ndi Timmkoo.
sel_only_local_generic: Sankhani phukusi la firmware lapafupi (.zip, .rar) kapena chikwatu chomwe chili ndi fayilo yomwaza kuti muyike popanda intaneti, imagwira ntchito ndi zida za MediaTek.
sel_offline_install: Ikani fimuweya kuchokera pa .zip kapena .rar wapamwamba pa aliyense Innioasis kapena Timmkoo audio player.
sel_offline_install_generic: Ikani fimuweya kuchokera mu .zip/.rar archive kapena fimuweya foda pa zipangizo generic MediaTek.
sel_update_available: Pali zosintha za {software} zomwe zilipo kwa {model} yanu.
conn_offline: Simunagwiritse ntchito intaneti. Kuyika kwa Community Firmware Archive sikukupezeka.
conn_archive_unavailable: Kalozera wa firmware sangathe kupezeka kwakanthawi. Mutha kuyikabe kuchokera pazosungidwa zakale kapena mafayilo am'deralo.
single_instance_body: Kope lina ndi lotseguka, kapena likuyendabe chakumbuyo. Makope awiri angapikisane ndi kugwirizana kwa USB kwa wosewera mpira, kotero uyu sangayambe.
single_instance_focus_failed: Kuthamanga sikunayankhe pempho losonyeza zenera lake. Itha kukhala yotanganidwa kapena yopachikidwa. Kukakamiza kusiya kusokoneza chilichonse chomwe ikukhazikitsa.
single_instance_force_failed: Kutulutsa sikunathe. Siyani nokha, ndiye yambitsaninso zowonjezera.
single_instance_busy_body: Kope lomwe likuyendetsa ndikukhazikitsa mapulogalamu kapena kuyankhula ndi wosewera mpira, chifukwa chake kutha tsopano kungasokoneze izi. Kukhazikitsa uku kutseka; gwiritsani ntchito zenera lomwe lilipo kapena chizindikiro chake cha menyu mukamaliza kukhazikitsa.
notices_how_community: Momwe zidziwitso za anthu ammudzi zimagwirira ntchito
notices_summary_body: Tsegulani Zidziwitso mu pulogalamuyi kuti muwerenge.
toast_battery_charged: Musanagwiritse ntchito izi pa wosewera mpira wanu, sungani batire kwa ola limodzi
toast_battery_charged_device: Musanagwiritse ntchito izi pa chipangizo chanu, yonjezerani batire kwa ola limodzi
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Yambitsani zidziwitso zakumbuyo kuti mulandire zosintha ndikutulutsa zidziwitso ngakhale Updater itatsekedwa pa menyu.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Yambitsani zidziwitso zakumbuyo kuti mulandire zosintha ndikutulutsa zidziwitso ngakhale Updater itatsekedwa ku tray yamakina.
translate_unavailable_notice_body: Zomasulira zapaintaneti sizikupezeka pano kapena zikungokhazikika. Zolemba zoyambirira zidzawonetsedwa m'malo mwake.
translate_unavailable_hint: Zomasulira sizikupezeka kwakanthawi. Yang'anani kulumikizidwa kwanu pa intaneti kapena yesaninso nthawi ina.
sel_notes_hint: Sankhani kumasulidwa kuti muwone kusintha kwake
flash_wait_desc: Zimitsani chipangizo choyamba. Ngati cholumikizidwa koma sichinazindikirike, yesani chingwe cha USB kapena doko lina.
dialog_pre_install_header: Chonde onetsetsani kuti {model} yanu yazimitsidwa ndipo sinalumikizidwe ndi USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Kuzimitsa kwathunthu chipangizo chanu musanayambe.
• Ngati chipangizocho chazizira kapena sichikuyankha, gwiritsani ntchito pini kapena paperclip mubowo lokhazikitsiranso kuti muzimitse magetsi kuti mutsitse.
• Sungani chingwe cha USB chosalumikizidwa pakadali pano.
• Dinani Pitirizani, kenako gwirizanitsani chipangizo chanu kudzera pa USB mukafunsidwa.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Kuzimitsa kwathunthu chipangizo chanu cha MediaTek.
• Sungani chingwe cha USB chosalumikizidwa pakadali pano.
• Kutengera mtundu, yesani kulumikizana ndi batire kapena osayika (kapena gwirani Voliyumu Pansi / Mmwamba mukulumikiza).
• Dinani Pitirizani, kenako gwirizanitsani chingwe cha USB mukafunsidwa.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Sitingathe kusunga data yanu yoyikiratu chifukwa pulogalamu yanu yamakono sigwirizana ndi Keep Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Lumikizani chingwe cha USB ndikugwiritsira ntchito paperclip kapena pini kukanikiza batani lokhazikitsiranso, kenako yesani kulumikizanso.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Ndikoyenera kulumikiza wosewera mpira ku charger pakhoma kwa mphindi 30 mpaka ola musanayese kulumikiza.
flash_hint_install_drivers: • Ngati muli pa Windows, onetsetsani kuti Mwaika Ma Driver.
flash_hint_windows_reboot_driver: • Makompyuta a Windows akuyenera kuyambikanso mukayika dalaivala musanagwiritse ntchito koyamba.
keep_data_running_fmt_no_name: Kodi pulogalamuyo idayikidwa kale pa {model} yanu?
install_first_which_firmware: Ndi pulogalamu iti yomwe ikugwira ntchito pa {model} yanu?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Ngati simukutsimikiza, sankhani 'Zina' kapena pulogalamu yomwe mukuganiza kuti yayikidwa.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Kuti mupitilize kukhazikitsa uku, chonde tsimikizirani ngati {model} yanu ikuyendetsa kale mapulogalamu ofunikira ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Titha kungosunga zokonda zanu ndi media pomwe wosewera akuyendetsa kale pulogalamuyi kapena mtundu wogwirizana.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Titha kusunga makonda anu pokhapokha wosewera mpira akuyendetsa pulogalamuyo kapena mtundu wogwirizana.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Titha kungosunga zokonda zanu ndi media pomwe wosewera akuyendetsa kale pulogalamuyi kapena mtundu wogwirizana.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Lolani Sungani Zikhazikiko ndi Media pa kukhazikitsa kulikonse kwa firmware
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Yalumpha funso lofanana. Ingogwiritsani ntchito ngati mukutsimikiza kuti wosewerayo azigwirabe ntchito ndi zoikamo zake ndi media.
err_keep_data_failed: Simunathe kusunga zokonda zanu ndi media: chikwatu cha firmware sichimalembedwa. Palibe chomwe chidayikidwa.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Imasunga makonda anu ndi media pa player. Ena onse mapulogalamu anaika monga mwachizolowezi.
flash_keep_data_warning: Mukapitiliza popanda izi, zokonda zanu ndi media zidzakhazikitsidwanso pazosungira zamkati za osewera.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Mukapitiliza popanda izi, mitu yanu ya Rockbox, mafonti ndi zoikamo zidzachotsedwa. Nyimbo zanu ndi makanema ena azikhala pawosewera mpira.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Mukapitiliza popanda izi, mitu yanu ya Rockbox, mafonti ndi zoikamo zidzachotsedwa, ndipo zosungira zamkati za wosewerayo zidzakhazikitsidwanso.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Ngati mupitiliza popanda izi, zokonda zanu zidzakonzedwanso. Nyimbo zanu ndi makanema ena azikhala pawosewera mpira.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Firmware iyi iyenera kusinthanso zosungira zamkati za osewera. Zokonda zosungidwa zidzachotsedwa; nyimbo zanu ndi zofalitsa zina zidzakhalabe m'malo.
format_all_data_warning_other: Firmware iyi iyenera kusinthanso zosungira zamkati za osewera. Zokonda zosungidwa ndi media zosungidwa pazosungidwa zosungidwa zidzachotsedwa. Media pa microSD yanu imakhalabe m'malo.
format_all_confirm_body:
Pa {software} tikufunika kukonzanso {model} yosungirako mkati mwanu tisanapitirize. Kenako kuyesa kwina kwa SP Flash Tool kudzayesedwa, koma mu Format All + Download mode kudzera pa XML console-mode run.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Lumikizani USB, kenako ikani pepala kapena pini mubowo lokhazikitsanso pa {model} yanu. Dinani Next kuti muyesenso mu Format All + Download mode.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool inanena kuti tebulo la magawo a wosewera linasintha (8502). Firmware iyi iyenera kukhazikitsidwa mumtundu wa Format All + Download, womwe umasinthira kusungirako kwamkati.
install_first_hint: Musanakhazikitse {target} kwa nthawi yoyamba, {model} yanu iyenera kukhala ikuyenda {software} - kapena {target} yokha, ngati idayikidwa kale ndikugwira ntchito.
install_first_power_on_fmt: Chonde chotsani USB, yambitsani {model} yanu ndikudina Next.
install_first_power_on_hint: Lolani wosewerayo ayambe kamodzi pa firmware yoyambira, ndiyeno muzimitsa kuti muyikenso.
install_first_need_body: {target} imagwira ntchito bwino mukayamba ndi {software} pa {model} yanu. Tikhazikitsa {software} poyamba, kenako n'kupitiriza {target} basi.
install_first_when_body: {target} siyenera kukhazikitsidwa molunjika pa {running}. Pa {model} yanu wosewera sangayambe bwino pambuyo pake. Kuyika {software} choyamba ndi njira yotetezeka, ndipo {target} kumatsatira zokha.
install_first_when_body_unnamed: {target} sichiyenera kukhazikitsidwa molunjika pa pulogalamu yomwe ili kale pa {model} yanu: wosewerayo sangayambe bwino pambuyo pake. Kuyika {software} choyamba ndi njira yotetezeka, ndipo {target} kumatsatira zokha.
install_first_recommend_body: {model} yanu ikuyenda {running}. Kuyika {target} pamwamba pake kumatha kusunga {running} chizindikiro choyambira ndi ma logo a zida zomwe mwamakonda. Kuyika {software} choyamba ndiye njira yoyeretsera: {target} kenako kumangotsatira. Inde imayika {software} poyamba; Palibe kuyika {target} tsopano ndi zoikamo zatsopano ndi media.
install_first_missing: Firmware iyi imafuna {software} poyamba, koma kalozera alibe kutulutsidwa kwa {software}.
install_first_version_unavailable: Firmware iyi imafunikira {software} {version}, koma palibe kutulutsidwa mumndandanda komwe kumafanana ndi zomwe zimafunikira.
install_first_needs_answer: Firmware iyi imafunikira cheke choyambira cha firmware, chomwe chimafunikira terminal yolumikizirana.
keep_data_microsd_reassurance: Makanema anu pa microSD yanu nthawi zonse amakhala m'malo
keep_data_erase_prompt_other: Ikani ndi kufufuta zochunira ndi zowonera pazosungidwa zamkati pa {model} yanu?

SP Flash Tool GUI tsopano iyamba.

• Ngati sichinazimitsidwe, thimitsani chipangizo chanu.

support_story_1_headline: Pamene opanga akupita patsogolo, anthu ammudzi amapita patsogolo.
support_story_1_lead: Kuteteza chipangizo chanu ku misampha yachete ya hardware ndi zosintha zosweka.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis nthawi zonse imatulutsa ma firmware atsopano kwa osewera ngati Y1 (kutsata zosintha zobisika monga 6.0, 7.0, ndi 8.0) zomwe zimaphwanya mwakachetechete zida zakale. Choyipa kwambiri, tsamba lawo limapereka machenjezo a zero ndi zero mwayi wofikira ku firmwares yapitayi kuti achire kuchokera kumalo omangidwa. Updater ndi pulojekiti ya Community Firmware zimatenga zidutswa zake: timasunga zolemba zonse za ROM, timatsimikizira zokha kukonzanso kwa zida zanu, ndikusunga wosewera wanu akuthamanga mosatekeseka.
support_story_1_item_1: Kupulumutsa Osewera Osweka: Kuwunika kwachitetezo kumawonetsetsa kuti zosintha zatsopano sizimangokhala njerwa zakale.
support_story_1_item_2: Ma ROM Osungidwa Osungidwa: Kutolere kwathunthu kwamafakitale oyambilira a Innioasis achotsedwa.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Zida zowunikira zonse za macOS, Linux, ndi Windows chimodzimodzi.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Kudziwikiratu kwa board kuti mumapeza phukusi loyenera nthawi zonse.
support_story_2_headline: Palibe Ma Drives a Google osweka. Palibe kungoganiza-ntchito. Ingogwira ntchito firmware.
support_story_2_lead: Malo othamanga kwambiri, otsimikiziridwa ammudzi omwe mungadalire.
support_story_2_body: Kutsata pulogalamu ya Innioasis yovomerezeka nthawi zambiri kumatanthawuza kuyang'ana mabwalo a maulalo a Google Drive omwe atha ntchito, magawo amtambo a Baidu akufa, ndi mafayilo achinsinsi a zip opanda zida zowunikira. Tinapanga netiweki yodalirika, yodziyimira payokha yokhala ndi kukhulupirika kotsimikizika kwa SHA-256, zidziwitso zosintha, ndikuyika motsogozedwa ndi sitepe ndi sitepe. Zopereka zanu zimasunga mwachindunji kutsitsa ndi kuchititsa kuti izi zitheke maola 24 patsiku, masiku 365 pachaka.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Kutsitsa mwachangu, mwachindunji popanda malire otsitsa kapena maulalo akufa.
support_story_2_item_2: Zidziwitso Zosintha: Dziwitsani pomwe zatsopano zatulutsidwa kapena kukonza kutsika.
support_story_2_item_3: Kuyika Kwapang'onopang'ono Motsogozedwa: Zowonetsa zomveka bwino zimakuyendetsani pa batani lililonse.
support_story_2_item_4: Gulu la Zilankhulo Zambiri: Amapezeka kwathunthu mu Chingerezi, Chitchaina, Chijeremani, Chisipanishi, Chifalansa & Chijapani.
support_story_3_headline: Kutsegula kuthekera kwathunthu kwa wosewera wanu wa Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Kubweretsa Rockbox, machitidwe opepuka opepuka, ndi ufulu wa audiophile.
support_story_3_body: Mapulogalamu afakitale amangokanda pamwamba pazomwe Y1 kapena Y2 hardware yanu ingachite. Dera lathu lidabweretsa Rockbox, makina opepuka ogwiritsira ntchito, kusewera ma codec a audiophile, ndi mitu yanthawi zonse. Timagula ma hardware akuthupi kunja kwa thumba kuti tiyese, kusintha mainjiniya, ndikutsimikizira kuyika kulikonse. Kuthandizira Updater kumapereka ndalama mwachindunji magawowa ndikufulumizitsa chitukuko cha firmware.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Kusewerera kwa Audiophile ndi mitu yokhazikika imayikidwa mumasekondi.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware ya Community: Zowonjezera mabatire, UI yoyeretsa, komanso chithandizo chamakono cha codec.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Timayesa pazida zenizeni tisanatulutse chilichonse.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% yaulere, pulogalamu yachinsinsi-yoyamba yopanda zotsatsa kapena kutsatira.
support_story_4_lead: Kutetezedwa koyendetsedwa ndi firmware komwe kumateteza zida zanu kuti zisatayike.
support_story_4_body: Kampani ya hardware ikapita ku chida chawo chotsatira, zitsanzo zakale zimasiyidwa. Innioasis imapereka chithandizo cha Linux, palibe zosintha zowonekera, ndipo palibe njira yosavuta yobwezeretsanso ikalephera. Updater ilipo chifukwa ogwiritsa ntchito mwachidwi sayenera kutaya wosewera wabwino kwambiri. 100% ya zopereka zamagulu zimapita mwachindunji kuti chida ichi chitsegulidwe kwa aliyense.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Kubwezeretsa kotsimikizika kumayenda ngakhale zida zikana kuyambiranso.
support_story_4_item_2: Thandizo la Kalasi Yoyamba ya Linux: MediaTek yothandizidwa mokwanira ikuwunikira pa Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Zolemba zambiri zotulutsa kuti mudziwe zomwe zimasintha.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Yothandizidwa ndi Community: Khofi aliyense amasunga zosungirako zotseguka komanso zaulere kwa onse.

settings_no_devices_tracked: Palibe makina oyika zida omwe adajambulidwa. Onetsani chipangizo kuti muyambitse kutsata mtundu.
settings_hide_donations_tip: Zimitsani kuti mubise makhadi ndi malangizo a zopereka kuti muwoneke bwino.
settings_skip_install_donations_tip: Onetsani zambiri zomaliza popanda kupempha zopereka mutawunikira.
settings_cache_desc: Chotsani phukusi la firmware lomwe latsitsidwa ndikuchotsa mafayilo a ROM kuti mumasule malo a disk. Mbiri yanu yoyikiratu ndi zokonda zanu zachikumbutso zimasungidwa.

reminder_prompt_install: Kodi mungakonde kuyiyambitsa (ndi njira yomwe mwasankha: {method})?
retry_guidance_intro: Kulumikiza kwa USB kwa wosewera wanu kwasiya kuyankha. Wosewera wanu akufunika kukonzanso pamanja musanayesenso ntchito ina.
retry_guidance_step_1: 1. Chotsani USB chingwe kwa wosewera mpira wanu.
retry_guidance_step_2: 2. Dinani batani lokhazikitsiranso lobisika ndi pini, pepala lojambula kapena ndolo.
retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Lumikizani chingwe cha USB mkati, ndikuyesanso.
onboarding_after_add_body: Tikudziwitsani za zosintha ndi zovuta zomwe anthu amderali ananena za mapulogalamuwa pamitundu iyi:
onboarding_after_add_body_in_app: Tikudziwitsani mu pulogalamuyi za zosintha ndi zovuta zomwe anthu ammudzi amachitira pa mapulogalamuwa pamitundu iyi:
onboarding_after_add_body_background_men: Tikudziwitsani kudzera pazidziwitso zamakina ngakhale mutatseka pa menyu za zosintha ndi zovuta zomwe anthu ammudzi amachitira pa mapulogalamuwa pamitundu iyi:

onboarding_after_add_footer:
Kudziwa mapulogalamu omwe chipangizo chanu chili nawo kumatsimikizira kuti kuyika kumachitika moyenera pamapulogalamu onse omwe akupezeka mu pulogalamuyi.

Ngati mwamaliza kuwonjezera zida, ingodinani Wachita kuti muyambe kugwiritsa ntchito Updater.
onboarding_body: Tiuzeni mapulogalamu omwe wosewera aliyense akuyendetsa, ndipo tidzakudziwitsani zosintha zikatuluka, sungani zokonda zanu ndikukuthandizani ngati instalar ilakwika. Onjezani wosewera mpira wanu tsopano kuti zonse ziyambe kugwira ntchito kuyambira pakukhazikitsa koyamba.
onboarding_version_hint: Sindikudziwa kuti ndi mtundu uti? Pa Original Software ili pansi pa Zikhazikiko › About pa player.

settings_reminders_tracked_original_in_a: Tikudziwitsani mu pulogalamuyi pulogalamu yatsopano ya {model} yanu ikatulutsidwa.

settings_reminders_tracked_original_bg_s: Tikudziwitsani kudzera pazidziwitso zamakina ngakhale mutatsekeredwa pathireyi yamakina mutatulutsa pulogalamu yatsopano ya {model} yanu.
settings_reminders_tracked_named: Tikudziwitsani mtundu watsopano wa {software} ukatulutsidwa {model} yanu.
settings_reminders_tracked_named_in_app: Tikudziwitsani mu pulogalamuyi mtundu watsopano wa {software} ukatulutsidwa {model} yanu.
settings_reminders_tracked_named_bg_menu: Tidzakudziwitsani kudzera pazidziwitso zamakina ngakhale mutatsekedwa pazakudya zopatsa thanzi pomwe mtundu watsopano wa {software} watulutsidwa {model} yanu.
settings_reminders_tracked_named_bg_syst: Tikudziwitsani kudzera pazidziwitso zamakina ngakhale mutatsekedwa ku tray yamakina pomwe mtundu watsopano wa {software} watulutsidwa {model} yanu.
settings_reminders_tracked_multi: Tikudziwitsani mitundu yatsopano ya izi ikatulutsidwa.
settings_reminders_tracked_multi_in_app: Tikudziwitsani mu pulogalamuyi mitundu yatsopanoyi ikatulutsidwa.
settings_reminders_tracked_multi_bg_menu: Tikudziwitsani kudzera pazidziwitso zamakina ngakhale zitatsekedwa pa menyu kapamwamba mitundu yatsopano ikatulutsidwa.
settings_reminders_tracked_multi_bg_syst: Tikukudziwitsani kudzera pazidziwitso zamakina ngakhale mutatseka thireyi yamakina atsopano akatulutsidwa.
flash_method_note_mtk_mac: Makina oyeserera a macOS: imayendetsa kayendedwe ka Mac pamakina awa, MTKClient ndiyo yokhayo yobwereranso kumbuyo komanso zowunikira za macOS zimawonetsedwa. Kwa kuyesa kokha; pulogalamuyi iyambiranso kugwiritsa ntchito.
simulated_mac_body_mediatek: MTKClient imakhala njira yokhayo yokhazikitsira ndipo malangizo amtundu wa macOS amawonetsedwa. MediaTek Installer ikufunika kuyambitsanso kuti igwiritse ntchito izi.
simulated_mac_body: MTKClient imakhala njira yokhayo yokhazikitsira ndipo malangizo amtundu wa macOS amawonetsedwa. Updater iyenera kuyambiranso kuti igwiritse ntchito izi.
sel_instructions_below: Chonde tsatirani malangizo omwe ali pansipa kuti muyike pulogalamuyi pa {lbl} yanu
sel_type_help_tooltip: Yesani Type A System Software poyamba. Ngati gudumu lanu la mpukutu silikuyankha mutakhazikitsa, yikani imodzi mwazosankha za Type B. Zida za Type B ndizomwe zidabwera ndi mitundu ya firmware kale kuposa 2.0.
sel_refresh_tooltip: Tsitsaninso mndandanda wa mapulogalamu omwe alipo
device_type_help_msg:
Yesani Type A System Software poyamba.

Ngati gudumu lanu la mpukutu silikuyankha mutakhazikitsa, yikani imodzi mwazosankha za Type B.

Zida za Type B ndizomwe zidabwera ndi mitundu ya firmware kale kuposa 2.0.
install_power_on_steps_fmt: Kuti muyatse {label} yanu, chotsani USB ndikugwiritsitsa {button}.
rockbox_y1_theme_warning_prompt: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org - you'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1 - click next to continue
sp_gui_prompt_steps_fmt:
• Ngati sichinazimitsidwe, zimitsani {label} yanu.
• Ngati chikugwirizana ndi USB, chotsani kaye.
• Mu SP Flash Tool, dinani Download.

Ndiye kulumikiza USB chingwe kuyamba kung'anima.

Ngati gudumu lanu la mpukutu silikuyankha mutakhazikitsa, yikani imodzi mwazosankha za Type B.

sel_install_tooltip_generic: Ikani pulogalamu yosankhidwa pa chipangizo chanu
linux_engine_staged_desc: MediaTek SP Flash Tool yopangidwa ndi libpng12 yogwirizana.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Dinani Onaninso kapena yambitsaninso kukhazikitsa kuti mutsitse phukusi.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: Malamulo a MediaTek akugwira ntchito (/etc/udev/rules.d/). Kufikira pakompyuta ndikoyatsidwa.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Perekani zilolezo kamodzi kuti pulogalamuyi izitha kulumikizana ndi chipangizo chanu.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Zilolezo za USB & malamulo a udev adayikidwa bwino. Ntchito zakonzedwa.
donate_rely_on_you: Tithandizeni ndi ndalama zoyendetsera ntchito, perekani lero.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Tsegulani MediaTek SP Flash Tool GUI
status_app_reset_defaults: Pulogalamuyo idasinthidwa kukhala zosasintha, kutsitsa cache kuchotsedwa, ndi chikumbutso cha batri chabwezeretsedwa.
log_app_reset_defaults: Kukonzekera kwa pulogalamu kumasinthidwa kukhala zosasintha, kutsitsa cache kuchotsedwa, chikumbutso cha batri chabwezeretsedwa (R).
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Isungeni yolumikizidwa, Rockbox ikuyamba ndipo mitu yake idzawonjezedwa yokha.
flash_watch_found: Wosewera wapezeka, ndikuwonjezera mitu ya Rockbox…
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Onetsetsani kuti chalumikizidwa ndikuyatsa. Kukakhala mdima, dinani pini mu dzenje lobwezeretsanso ndikugwirizira batani lapakati (Y1) kapena batani lamphamvu (osewera ena) kuti muyambitsenso. Ngati sichidzayambabe, firmware sinatenge, yikani ina.
task_writing_partition_generic: Kulemba gawo la firmware la chipangizo
action_recover_powercycle: Kuzungulira kwamphamvu kwa wosewera mpira (kugwirani mphamvu ~ 10s), kenaka mulumikizenso - kuyesanso...
action_wait_mtk: Tikuyembekezera chipangizo cha MTK... Zimitsani chipangizo ndikulumikiza USB.
action_da_stall: Chipangizo chinasiya kuyankha chikukonza chotsitsa. Zimitseni kwathunthu, gwirizanitsaninso, ndikuyesanso.
action_da_wait_back: Wosewera adasiya kuyankha pomwe akuyamba kutsitsa. Kudikirira kuti ibwerere...
action_formatting: Kupanga data ya ogwiritsa ntchito ndi posungira...
action_restart_brom: Kuyambitsanso wosewera mpira kukhala BROM mode...
log_install_writing: Ikani mu Progress - kulemba zithunzi za firmware...
log_sparse_fmt: Tapeza chithunzi chochepa cha Android cha {part}, chikusinthidwa mkati ...
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Kutsimikizira kwa tebulo la magawo sikunatheke pambuyo polemba
err_sp_wrong_model: Mwalumikiza mtundu wolakwika wa osewera. Dinani batani la × kuti muletse kukhazikitsa uku, kenako sankhani mapulogalamu a osewera omwe mudalumikiza.
err_sp_timeout: Chidacho sichinawonepo wosewera mpira. Isungeni yozimitsa ndi kumasulidwa, kenaka lumikizani chingwe cha USB mukafunsidwa.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Wosewerayo adayimilira mwachangu kwambiri. Zimitseni kwathunthu, kenako gwirizanitsaninso.
err_sp_download_fail: Kulemba kunasokonezedwa. Yang'anani chingwe cha USB ndi doko ndi mtengo wa batri, kenako yesaninso.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Wotsitsa sakanayamba. Yesani njira ina yowunikira.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Wotsitsa sakanatumizidwa kwa wosewera mpira. Zimitsani ndikulumikizanso.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Wosewera wakana wotsitsa (zolakwika 6104). Gwiritsani ntchito Download Agent yomangidwa ndi SP Flash Tool, ndikuwona ngati fimuweya ikufanana ndi wosewera uyu.
err_sp_com_port: Chidacho sichinathe kutsegula doko lake lachinsinsi. Tsekani zida zina zowunikira ndikulumikizanso.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Doko la USB COM silinatsegulidwe (zolakwika 1013). Kuyambitsanso kompyuta yanu kumasula doko lokhoma. Chonde yambitsaninso kompyuta yanu ndikuyesanso.
err_sp_enable_dram: Chidacho sichinathe kuyambitsa kukumbukira kwa osewera. Gwiritsani ntchito phukusi lomwe lapangidwira chitsanzo chenichenicho.
err_sp_storage_read: Chida sichinathe kuwerenga zosungira za osewera. Onani kugwirizana; chipangizocho chikhoza kukhala ndi vuto la hardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Chida chowunikira sichinawonetse kupita patsogolo mkati mwa masekondi {seconds}, kotero kuyesaku kudayimitsidwa.
err_connection_failed_desc: Sitinathe kukhazikitsa kulumikizana kokhazikika ndi wosewera mpira. Onetsetsani kuti chipangizocho chazimitsidwa (gwiritsani ntchito pini kukanikiza batani lokonzanso ngati pakufunika), chotsani USB, ndikulumikizanso mukafunsidwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Kuwunikira kudasokonekera kapena kulemba kwalephera. Onetsetsani kuti chingwe cha USB chalumikizidwa mwamphamvu ndipo batire ili ndi mtengo wokwanira, ndiye yesaninso.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Chida chowunikira chawonetsa mzere womwewo kwa masekondi {seconds} omaliza ndipo sizikuwoneka kuti zikupitiliza kulemba firmware. Kuwalako mwina kwalephera. Ngati uku kunali komaliza mwa kuyesa kuwiri ndi njira iliyonse pamakina omwe angabwerere pakati pawo, kapena ngati MTKClient ikupezeka pamakinawa, yambitsaninso kompyutayo ndikuyesanso.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Ndi MTKClient yokha yomwe ilipo pakuyikiraku. Kuwalako mwina kwalephera. Chonde yambitsaninso kompyuta ndikuyesanso.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Kompyutayi imathanso kukhazikitsa pogwiritsa ntchito SP Flash Tool. Ngati mungathe, sinthani ku SP Flash Tool ndikuyesanso.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Kuwalako mwina kwalephera. Chonde werengani uthenga womwe uli pamwambapa ndikuyambitsanso kompyuta musanayesenso. Mukadina Chabwino, pulogalamuyi isiya kuti muyambitsenso.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Phukusi la firmware likusowa fayilo yomwaza kapena mafayilo ofunikira. Chonde tsitsaninso phukusili kapena sankhani fayilo yonse ya firmware.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Fayilo yotsimikizira yomwe mwasankha ilibe, ilibe kapena sinalembedwe. Sankhani fayilo yolondola, kapena chotsani mu Zochunira, kenako wunikiraninso.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Chida chowunikira kapena madalaivala ofunikira sanathe kukhazikitsidwa. Chonde onani zilolezo zamakina, kuyika madalaivala, kapena kuyikanso pulogalamuyo.
err_driver_missing_desc: Vutoli limatha kuchitika ngati dalaivala wa MediaTek USB sanayikidwe. Dinani Tsitsani Madalaivala kuti muyike dalaivala wa MediaTek USB, yambitsaninso kompyuta yanu, ndikuyesanso.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Fayilo yosungidwa ya firmware ikusowa. Sankhani Sankhani Mapulogalamu kuti mumangenso mafayilo ochotsedwa kapena kutsitsanso mbiri ya firmware. Ili ndi vuto la fayilo yanu, osati vuto lolumikizana ndi USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Bwererani ku Sankhani Mapulogalamu kuti mumangenso kapena kutsitsa phukusi la firmware.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Sankhani mtundu wa firmware kuti mutsitsenso.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Cholakwika chosayembekezereka chidachitika pakukhazikitsa ({detail}). Zimitsani wosewerayo kwathunthu, gwirizanitsaninso mukafunsidwa, ndikuyesanso.
flash_method_confirm: Njira yoyika yasinthidwa kukhala {method}. Tsimikizirani kuti wosewerayo watulutsidwa ndikuzimitsidwa, kenako dinani Kenako.
flash_failover_note: {method} sinayambitse kukhazikitsa. Wosewerayo atazimitsidwa ndikumasulidwa, {other} idzagwiritsidwa ntchito m'malo mwake.
themepack_card_desc: Mulinso mitu yokongola yapagulu, zakumbuyo zowoneka bwino, ndi mafonti opangidwa makamaka kuti aziwonetsa 360p.
themepack_step1_title: Gawo 1: Lumikizani mu USB Storage Mode
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Yatsani player wanu ndi kugwira Mphamvu batani.
2. Pamene Rockbox nsapato, pulagi ndi USB chingwe mu kompyuta.
3. Ngati mutafunsidwa pazenera la player, tsimikizirani USB Storage mode kuti chipangizocho chiwoneke ngati galimoto.
themepack_step2_title: Gawo 2: Sankhani Chikwatu chilichonse pa Player
themepack_step2_desc: Chifukwa machitidwe ogwiritsira ntchito (monga macOS) amabisa ma dotfiles (monga .rockbox) mwachisawawa, mukhoza kusankha ALIYONSE foda kapena muzu woyendetsa pa wosewera mpira wanu. Tidzakupezerani kapena kukupangani chikwatu cha .rockbox.
themepack_complete: Paketi yamutu idayikidwa bwino! Tsopano mutha kulumikiza wosewera wanu mosamala ndikusankha mutu mu Rockbox (Zikhazikiko> Zokonda Zamutu).
themepack_err_not_found: Sitinathe kupeza kapena kuyambitsa chikwatu cha .rockbox pagalimoto yosankhidwa. Chonde onetsetsani kuti mwasankha chikwatu pa wosewera mpira wanu.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Chotsani chingwe cha USB.
2. Mphamvu wosewera mpira kumbuyo ndipo mulole izo jombo mu Rockbox.
3. Rockbox ikayamba, gwirizanitsaninso chingwe cha USB, kenako dinani Pitirizani.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Gawo 2: Kuyang'ana wosewera mpira pa ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Pulogalamuyi ikuyang'ana kulumikizana kwa ADB (mpaka masekondi 30). Ngati chipangizo chikapezeka, mitu imasamutsidwa ndipo wosewerayo amayambiranso. Kupanda kutero, dumphani ku USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Palibe chipangizo cha ADB chomwe chapezeka mkati mwa masekondi 30; pitilizani ndi USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Palibe bayinare ya ADB yomwe ikupezeka ku pulogalamuyi; pitilizani ndi USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Kukankhira mitu ndi mafonti pa ADB ...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Kutengerapo kwa ADB kwalephera; kugweranso ku USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Ikani kudzera mu USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Yambitsani USB Kusungirako akafuna pa wosewera mpira kotero zikuoneka ngati pagalimoto.
2. Sankhani foda ILIYONSE pa wosewera mpira pansipa (.rockbox, Music, Themes, kapena muzu wa galimoto, foda yobisika ya .rockbox imakhala yokha).
3. Pulogalamuyi imaphatikiza mitu ndi mafonti a 360p, ndikulembanso mafayilo amtundu womwewo.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Tsopano mutha kulumikiza wosewerayo mosamala ndikusankha mutu mu Rockbox (Zikhazikiko> Zokonda Zamutu).
rockbox_cleanup_deleting: Kuchotsa chikwatu cha .rockbox kuchokera ku player...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Mapulogalamu anu atsopano adayikidwa, koma foda yakale ya .rockbox sinachotsedwe. Chotsani chikwatu cha .rockbox pa wosewera mpira ndi dzanja ngati mukufuna chiyambi choyera.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Osewera opitilira m'modzi alumikizidwa. Lumikizani enawo ndikusiya imodzi yokha yomwe yaikidwa.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Wosewera wapezeka. Kuyika mitu yamagulu & zilembo...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Gwirani batani lapakati kuti muyambitse Y1 yanu, gwirizanitsaninso USB, ndikusankha USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Gwirani batani lamphamvu kuti muyambitse wosewera wanu, gwirizanitsaninso USB, ndikusankha USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Chonde chotsani ndikuyatsa {model} yanu, kenako dinani Next
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Lumikizani USB, gwirani {button} kuti muyambitse {model}, kenako dinani Next.
rockbox_step_standalone_power_on_usb: Lumikizani {model} yanu kudzera pa USB, yatsani, kenako dinani Next.
rockbox_step_select_rockbox_folder: Chonde sankhani wosewera yekha kapena chikwatu cha .rockbox
rockbox_select_device_prompt: Ndi wosewera uti yemwe mukuyikira mitu ya Rockbox?
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Chonde yambitsani njira yosungiramo USB pa chipangizo chanu ndikudina Next
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Chonde yambitsani kusungirako kwa USB pa {model} yanu, kenako sankhani galimoto yomwe ikuwoneka
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Chonde sankhani wosewerayo kapena chimodzi mwa zikwatu zomwe zili pamenepo
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Chotsani USB ndi mphamvu pa Y1 yanu, kenako dinani Next.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Lumikizani USB ndi mphamvu pa {model} yanu, kenako dinani Next.
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Sankhani 'USB yosungirako mumalowedwe' pa wosewera mpira wanu.
2. Dinani 'Sakatulani Foda...' kusankha wosewera mpira wanu ndi kukhazikitsa mitu.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Kumanga kwa Rockbox kumeneku kumagwiritsa ntchito mitu ya 240 × 320, yomwe sinamangidwe. Pezani mitu yaulere ya wosewera wanu patsamba lamutu la Rockbox:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Ngati {model} yanu siyamba, chotsani USB, gwirani batani lamphamvu kuti ma 10 akhazikitsenso, ndikuyatsa. Kapena bwezeretsani mapulogalamu oyambirira.
err_storage_full_desc: Malo osungira atha pa kompyuta yanu. Chonde masulani malo a disk pagalimoto yanu ndikuyesanso.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Mtundu wakale wa Updater ukadali pakompyuta iyi ndipo umatenga malo a disk. Kuyichotsa kumamasula malo amenewo.
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Chotsani pulogalamu yakale ya Innioasis Updater ndi zikwatu zothandizira
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Sungani Zida Zapulatifomu za Android (ADB / Fastboot) zokhazikitsidwa
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Ngati simugwiritsa ntchito ADB kapena Fastboot kunja kwa Updater, sankhani kuchotsa ndi kubwezeretsanso zosungirako zina.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Tinayeretsa bwino zoikamo zakale ndikupezanso malo a disk.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Mtundu wakale wa Updater ukadali pakompyutayi. Kuyichotsa kumamasula malo a disk.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Izi zimachotseratu pulogalamu yakale, firmware yotsitsa, ndi mafayilo otsala.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Chotsani Zida Zapulatifomu za Android (ADB / Fastboot) komanso? Sankhani Sungani ngati mugwiritsa ntchito ADB.
log_btn_goto_file_tip: Vumbulutsani fayilo ya logi mu Finder / Explorer
settings_arm64_driver_note: Thandizo la Windows la ARM64 silinayesedwe.
